headlines.title: Analog Devices to Report Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results on Tuesday, November 24, 2026
headlines.summary: Analog Devices, Inc. (Nasdaq: ADI) today announced it will release financial results for the fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 at 7:00 a.m. Eastern time on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Following the press release, the Company will host a conference call at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time, the same day. Vincent Roche, Chair and CEO, Richard Puccio, Chief Financial Officer, and Jeff Ambrosi, Head of Investor Relations, will discuss ADI's results and business outlook.

headlines.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Is A Key Competitor In Digital Power ICs
headlines.summary: Analog Devices (NasdaqGS:ADI) has been identified as a key competitor in the expanding global digital power IC market. Demand from data centers, 5G infrastructure, and electric vehicles is cited as a major driver for digital power IC adoption. Industry analysts highlight digital power ICs as a crucial technology for managing power efficiency in large scale computing and electrified transport systems.

headlines.title: Analog Devices Recommends Shareholders Reject "Mini-Tender" Offer by Tutanota LLC
headlines.summary: Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) today announced that it has received notice of an unsolicited mini-tender offer by Tutanota LLC ("Tutanota") to purchase up to 100,000 shares of ADI common stock at a price of $525.00 per share in cash. The offer price of $525.00 per share is conditioned on, among other things, the closing price per share of ADI common stock exceeding $525.00 per share on the last trading day before the offer expires.

description: Analog Devices, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, testing, and marketing of integrated circuits (ICs), software, and subsystems products in the United States, rest of North and South America, Europe, Japan, China, and rest of Asia. It provides data converter products, which translate real-world analog signals into digital data, as well as translates digital data into analog signals; power management and reference products for power conversion, driver monitoring, sequencing, and energy management applications in the automotive, communications, industrial, and consumer markets; and power ICs that include performance, integration, and software design simulation tools for accurate power supply designs. The company also offers amplifiers to condition analog signals; and radio frequency and microwave ICs to support cellular infrastructure; and micro-electro-mechanical systems technology solutions, including accelerometers used to sense acceleration, gyroscopes for sense rotation, inertial measurement units to sense multiple degrees of freedom, and broadband switches for radio and instrument systems, as well as isolators. In addition, it provides digital signal processing and system products for numeric calculations. The company serves clients in the industrial, automotive, consumer, instrumentation, aerospace, defense and healthcare, and communications markets through a direct sales force, third-party distributors, and independent sales representatives, as well as online. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
